lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, following the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary blobs to form a grid-like pattern along the posterior half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge running along the lateral midline, displaying a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several smaller accompanying fish (likely remoras) clustered near the ventral side of the pectoral fin and head.
